verdict.rationale: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is a national company registry. Its filings are held by the sovereign authority under its own jurisdiction, so letting a user pick a storage region is not a fair question for this kind of product. The only evidence is two HTTP 403 robots.txt walls, which say nothing that would make the residency axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
